A juror that skips cases loses 16% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool thus watches its influence decay while paying the yarrow fee to keep them eligible. A 271 account operation therefore ties up 6 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
